evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies BlockTemplateManager and interfaces::Mining to track template memory.
rationale: Tracks template memory footprint and exposes `getMemoryLoad()` over IPC to address unbounded memory pinning by external mining clients. Addresses issue #33899 with an active external consumer in Stratum v2 Template Provider PR stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63, providing the foundation needed to monitor and limit block template memory.
